Business Organization Search

SEARCH TIPS: If you have trouble finding a business, try the following:

  1. Enter one or more key words in the business name
  2. Use the % symbol for a wild card search.
    Example: searching for Fraternal Order Eagles 1234 ABCD, Inc.
    %Fraternal%1234%
  3. The search results will include what are commonly referred to as a fictitious business names in the results, if they have been registered with the State Tax Department.
